lines.zh: 岩浆从肩上滑下，滴进沙里。
lines.en: Lava slides off my shoulder and drips into the sand.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下焦黑的脚印。
lines.en: Every step leaves a scorched print.

lines.zh: 我不急，火不会自己走。
lines.en: I don't hurry; fire doesn't walk away.

lines.zh: 阳石在胸口发烫，照出前面的路。
lines.en: The sunstone in my chest glows and lights my path.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草叶卷了起来。
lines.en: I pass through grass, and the blades curl.

lines.zh: 灰烬从我背后落下，像一条尾巴。
lines.en: Ash trails behind me like a tail.

lines.zh: 石头在我脚下裂开，我听惯了。
lines.en: Stone cracks under my feet; I'm used to the sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩壁走，那里凉一点。
lines.en: I walk along the cliff, where it's a little cooler.

lines.zh: 走得太快，火会烧到自己。
lines.en: Walk too fast, and the fire burns me too.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声像炉膛里的闷响。
lines.en: My steps sound like a furnace's deep rumble.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，不想让火白白熄灭。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle; I won't let my fire die for nothing.

lines.zh: 前面有烟，也许还有我要找的东西。
lines.en: Smoke ahead — perhaps also what I'm looking for.

lines.zh: 我站着，等身上的火慢慢稳下来。
lines.en: I stand and let the fire on me settle.

lines.zh: 胸口那块阳石，一直亮着。
lines.en: The sunstone in my chest never stops glowing.

lines.zh: 我张开手，让岩浆滴成一串。
lines.en: I open my palm and let lava drip in a string.

lines.zh: 周围太安静，我拨了拨脚边的炭。
lines.en: It's too quiet; I stir the coals at my feet.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，只需要烧着。
lines.en: I don't need sleep, only to keep burning.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的火光晃了晃。
lines.en: The wind blows, and my flames waver.

lines.zh: 我把裂开的石头捏回一起。
lines.en: I press the cracked stone back together.

lines.zh: 有只虫子靠近，被热气逼退了。
lines.en: A bug comes near and the heat drives it back.

lines.zh: 我记得每一处火堆的位置。
lines.en: I remember where every fire pit lies.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己，像看一座小火山。
lines.en: I look down at myself like a small volcano.

lines.zh: 你站得够远了，再近就烫。
lines.en: You're standing far enough; closer and you'll burn.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在量你和我的距离。
lines.en: I look at you to measure the distance between us.

lines.zh: 你手里的水，是想浇我吗？
lines.en: Is that water in your hand meant for me?

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光照在墙上。
lines.en: My light throws your shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才不往前。
lines.en: Step back once, and I won't advance.

lines.zh: 我认得活着的东西的眼睛。
lines.en: I know the eyes of something alive.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，很凉。
lines.en: You smell of iron — cold iron.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，火焰跟着高了一寸。
lines.en: I fix on you, and my flames rise an inch.

lines.zh: 别背对我，那会让我误会。
lines.en: Don't turn your back; I might misread it.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我却不用。
lines.en: You blinked; I never need to.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我半边火。
lines.en: The blow scatters half my fire.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，岩浆洒在沙上。
lines.en: I step back, and lava spills on the sand.

lines.zh: 石头做的身体，也会裂。
lines.en: Even a body of stone can crack.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，那里冒的是烟。
lines.en: I press the wound, and smoke comes out.

lines.zh: 被打中的地方暗了一块。
lines.en: The struck spot goes dark.

lines.zh: 我的火低下去，又慢慢窜起来。
lines.en: My fire drops, then creeps back up.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，喉咙里像炉子响。
lines.en: I grit my teeth, and my throat rumbles like a furnace.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了它的武器。
lines.en: That blow taught me its weapon.

lines.zh: 我半跪下来，撑住地面。
lines.en: I drop to one knee and brace against the ground.

lines.zh: 灰从我身上掉了一层。
lines.en: A layer of ash falls off me.

lines.zh: 煤？那东西只会让我烧得更旺。
lines.en: Coal? That would only make me burn hotter.

lines.zh: 你把铁放在地上，我就当你献祭。
lines.en: Lay iron on the ground, and I'll take it as tribute.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只烧东西。
lines.en: I don't eat; I burn.

lines.zh: 那堆木柴不错，我走过去看看。
lines.en: That woodpile looks good; I walk over to it.

lines.zh: 你举起火把，我的火跟着动了。
lines.en: You raise a torch, and my flame leans toward it.

lines.zh: 阳石在你手里？还给我。
lines.en: A sunstone in your hand? Give it back.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，不是要拿，是要烧。
lines.en: I reach out not to take, but to burn.

lines.zh: 你退开，这堆柴归我了。
lines.en: Stand back; this pile of wood is mine.

lines.zh: 火靠近火，总想合在一起。
lines.en: Fire near fire always wants to join.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只想要能烧的东西。
lines.en: I'm not greedy; I only want something to burn.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，衣服边立刻卷了。
lines.en: You bump into me, and your sleeve curls at once.

lines.zh: 我侧了一步，怕把你点着。
lines.en: I step aside so I don't set you alight.

lines.zh: 石头被我撞碎，你却没事。
lines.en: The stone breaks on me, and you're unharmed.

lines.zh: 别推，热气会先碰到你。
lines.en: Don't push; the heat will reach you first.

lines.zh: 我停住，脚下的沙在冒烟。
lines.en: I stop, and the sand under me smokes.

lines.zh: 你从左边过来，我的火偏向右边。
lines.en: You come from the left, and my fire leans right.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，给你留条路。
lines.en: I back half a step to leave you a path.

lines.zh: 我的肩碰到你的盾，烫出一圈印。
lines.en: My shoulder meets your shield and scorches a ring.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，可你跳开了。
lines.en: It was a light bump, but you leapt away.

lines.zh: 我不想碰你，火不听话。
lines.en: I don't mean to touch you; the fire won't obey.

lines.zh: 两团火靠近，光会亮一倍。
lines.en: Two fires draw near and the light doubles.

lines.zh: 我把一块阳石推给她。
lines.en: I push a piece of sunstone toward her.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，岩浆流到一起。
lines.en: We stand side by side, and our lava runs together.

lines.zh: 她比我热，我往旁边让了让。
lines.en: She burns hotter than I do, so I shift aside.

lines.zh: 火与火之间，不用说话。
lines.en: Between two fires, no words are needed.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一处岩缝。
lines.en: We keep the same crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 她的火光映在我脸上。
lines.en: Her firelight falls across my face.

lines.zh: 夜里我们一起烧着，谁也没熄。
lines.en: At night we burn together, neither going out.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的那块石头留给她。
lines.en: I save the brightest stone for her.

lines.zh: 走近她时，我的火会低一点。
lines.en: Near her, my flames burn a little lower.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块煤，捏在掌心。
lines.en: I pick up a lump of coal and cup it in my palm.

lines.zh: 这块铁会化，我还是收着。
lines.en: This iron will melt, but I keep it anyway.

lines.zh: 我把石头里的火星抖出来。
lines.en: I shake the sparks out of the stone.

lines.zh: 那根木棍，被我捏成了炭。
lines.en: That stick turns to charcoal in my grip.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只用两根手指。
lines.en: I pick things up with only two fingers.

lines.zh: 这枚阳石碎片，跟我胸口的一样。
lines.en: This sunstone shard matches the one in my chest.

lines.zh: 东西太凉，我差点没拿住。
lines.en: It's so cold I nearly drop it.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的柴堆在岩缝口。
lines.en: I pile the wood I gathered at the rock crack.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西，一会儿就红了。
lines.en: Whatever I hold turns red soon enough.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，被我踩成了灰。
lines.en: What I dropped is now ash under my foot.

lines.zh: 你走进我的光里，我看见了。
lines.en: You stepped into my light, and I saw you.

lines.zh: 那点动静，躲不过我的火。
lines.en: That small noise can't hide from my fire.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心先亮起来。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and my palm lights first.

lines.zh: 它离火堆太近了，我不同意。
lines.en: It's too close to the fire pit; I object.

lines.zh: 我先站定，让它看清我有多高。
lines.en: I plant myself so it sees how tall I am.

lines.zh: 那身影在动，我的火跟着转向。
lines.en: That figure moves, and my flame turns with it.

lines.zh: 它拿着铁器，那就更该烧。
lines.en: It carries iron, which makes it more worth burning.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，近了就动手。
lines.en: I count its steps and strike when close.

lines.zh: 石缝里的热气，先替我报了信。
lines.en: The heat in the rock crack warns me first.

lines.zh: 我不追远的，只烧走近的。
lines.en: I don't chase the distant; I burn what comes near.

lines.zh: 我握紧拳，指缝里漏出火。
lines.en: I clench my fist, and fire leaks between my fingers.

lines.zh: 这块地方归我守，它越界了。
lines.en: I keep this ground, and it crossed the line.

lines.zh: 它身上有水汽，我先记下。
lines.en: There's moisture on it; I note that.

lines.zh: 它回头了，那就没有退路。
lines.en: It looked back, so there's no retreat now.

lines.zh: 你的影子拉到我脚边，太长了。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches my feet, and it is too long.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，岩缝亮了些。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you and the cracks brighten.

lines.zh: 火球在掌心转，我等它再近一步。
lines.en: A fireball spins in my palm; I wait one more step.

lines.zh: 它左右闪，我的火跟着画弧。
lines.en: It dodges left and right, and my fire draws arcs.

lines.zh: 我往前压，把它逼向岩壁。
lines.en: I press forward, driving it toward the cliff.

lines.zh: 它举盾，我就换个角度。
lines.en: It raises a shield, so I change my angle.

lines.zh: 我脚下的沙在结块，它退得慢了。
lines.en: The sand cakes under me, and its retreat slows.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我原地转，只动手腕。
lines.en: It circles; I turn in place, moving only my wrist.

lines.zh: 我在等它的水用完。
lines.en: I'm waiting for its water to run out.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，火球不用抬高。
lines.en: The range is right; I don't need to aim high.

lines.zh: 它喘气了，我听见了。
lines.en: It's panting, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我假装抬手，看它往哪躲。
lines.en: I feint a raise to see which way it dodges.

lines.zh: 它踩到我的炭，脚下一滑。
lines.en: It steps on my coals and slips.

lines.zh: 我把火压低，贴着地推过去。
lines.en: I lower the fire and push it along the ground.

lines.zh: 它背后的岩壁，替我挡住了路。
lines.en: The cliff behind it blocks its way for me.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就用拳头。
lines.en: Half a step closer, and I'll use my fists.

lines.zh: 我一步步移过去，火不离手。
lines.en: I close in step by step, fire never leaving my hand.

lines.zh: 你想绕后，我不回头也知道。
lines.en: You try to circle; I know without turning.

lines.zh: 我把手抬高，你便往低处躲。
lines.en: I raise my hand and you duck low.

lines.zh: 我等你的盾放下一点点。
lines.en: I wait for your shield to drop a little.

lines.zh: 这块地烫，你站不久。
lines.en: This ground is hot, and you cannot stand long.

lines.zh: 你的水袋晃了，我听见了。
lines.en: Your waterskin sloshes, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 一拳砸下，地面裂出焦痕。
lines.en: My fist lands, cracking the ground black.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的手臂，掌心发红。
lines.en: I seize its arm, and my palm glows red.

lines.zh: 火球贴着脸炸开，它后退了。
lines.en: The fireball bursts at its face, and it recoils.

lines.zh: 我横扫一臂，带起一片火星。
lines.en: I sweep an arm and scatter a sheet of sparks.

lines.zh: 它挡了一下，铁器烫得脱手。
lines.en: It blocks once, and the hot iron leaves its hand.

lines.zh: 我把它按在岩壁上，岩石开始发亮。
lines.en: I pin it to the cliff, and the rock begins to glow.

lines.zh: 我踢开它的脚，让它站不稳。
lines.en: I hook its foot so it loses balance.

lines.zh: 一团火先到，拳后到。
lines.en: The fireball arrives first, the fist second.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡它的刀，刀刃卷了。
lines.en: I block its blade with my arm; the edge curls.

lines.zh: 它退到水边，我的火矮了半截。
lines.en: It backs to the water, and my fire drops by half.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的披风，布立刻烧穿。
lines.en: I grab its cloak, and the cloth burns through.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在盾上，震得我手腕响。
lines.en: The fist hits its shield and my wrist rings.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我一脚踩住它的影子。
lines.en: It tries to flee, and I plant a foot on its shadow.

lines.zh: 我把它推开，火星跟着飞出去。
lines.en: I shove it away, and sparks fly with it.

lines.zh: 我的食指点了你一下，皮焦了。
lines.en: I tap you with one finger and your skin chars.

lines.zh: 我转身时，火扫过你的腿。
lines.en: As I turn, fire sweeps across your legs.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进火炉。
lines.en: You hit me like running into a furnace.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口，布料卷边。
lines.en: I seize your collar and the cloth curls.

lines.zh: 这一肘带着融岩的重量。
lines.en: This elbow carries the weight of molten rock.

lines.zh: 我按住你，石头在你背后烫。
lines.en: I pin you down and the stone burns at your back.

lines.zh: 岩缝裂开，我从里面站起来。
lines.en: The crack in the rock opens, and I rise out.

lines.zh: 第一口气，吸进来全是灰。
lines.en: My first breath is all ash.

lines.zh: 我胸口的阳石自己亮了。
lines.en: The sunstone in my chest lights on its own.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头还是热的。
lines.en: The stone under my feet is still hot.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见一片需要守的火。
lines.en: I look up and see a fire that needs keeping.

lines.zh: 岩浆顺着我的手臂流下来。
lines.en: Lava runs down my arm.

lines.zh: 岩浆与阳石铸成我，醒来就烧。
lines.en: Lava and sunstone made me. I woke up burning.

lines.zh: 这里的空气干得正好。
lines.en: The air here is dry in just the right way.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，周围暗了一瞬。
lines.en: When I stand, the surroundings dim for a moment.

lines.zh: 我先走了一圈，认下这片岩地。
lines.en: I walk one loop to claim this rocky ground.

lines.zh: 远处有水声，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I hear water far off, and I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我的火刚起，还不太稳。
lines.en: My fire has just caught and isn't steady yet.

lines.zh: 火对火，只会让我更旺。
lines.en: Fire against fire only makes me brighter.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁上摔下，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我的火嘶嘶地叫。
lines.en: Water hits me, and my fire hisses.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，石头飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and scatters stone.

lines.zh: 那支箭插进我肩膀，烧成了灰。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder and burns to ash.

lines.zh: 一股冷意压下来，火缩成一团。
lines.en: A cold pressure descends, and my fire shrinks.

lines.zh: 没有东西可烧，我的光暗了。
lines.en: Nothing left to burn, and my light dims.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，阳石亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and the sunstone flares.

lines.zh: 下面没有岩壁，我抓了个空。
lines.en: No rock below me; my hand closes on nothing.
